description: This file implements the PacFileDecider class responsible for selecting and fetching proxy auto-configuration (PAC) scripts, including fallback mechanisms, DNS resolution checks, and script validation within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: PacFileDecider
classes.description: Manages the process of selecting, fetching, and validating PAC scripts, including fallback strategies and DNS quick checks.

classes.name: PacFileDataWithSource
classes.description: Holds PAC script data along with its source information.

classes.name: PacSource
classes.description: Represents a source for PAC scripts, such as DHCP, DNS, or a custom URL.

methods.name: LooksLikePacScript
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a script resembles a PAC script by searching for 'FindProxyForURL'.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the PAC script fetching and validation process based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: OnIOCompletion
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations during the process.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop to process different states of the PAC script fetching and validation workflow.

methods.name: BuildPacSourcesFallbackList
methods.description: Constructs the list of fallback PAC sources based on the current configuration.

methods.name: DetermineURL
methods.description: Determines the effective URL for fetching the PAC script based on the source type.
